items.heading: Coconut Fish Marshallese
details: Key ingredients: reef fish, coconut milk, onion, lime
Season fish fillets with lime juice.
Simmer gently in coconut milk with onion.
Cook until the fish is tender and the sauce has thickened slightly.
Serve with rice or breadfruit.

items.heading: Breadfruit Chips
details: Key ingredients: breadfruit, oil, salt
Peel and slice breadfruit very thin.
Soak briefly in salted water.
Fry the slices in hot oil until golden and crisp.
Drain and salt lightly before serving.

items.heading: Breadfruit
details: Ingredients: flour, water, salt and fat; yeast or leavening when required.
Mix into a soft dough, rest, shape or roll, then cook on a hot griddle or bake until cooked and lightly browned.
